name: lemlist
summary: Multichannel prospecting tool with a lead database and sequences across email, LinkedIn, calls and WhatsApp.
description: lemlist finds prospects in a database of more than 650 million leads, verifies emails and phone numbers, and runs multichannel sequences across email, LinkedIn, calls, SMS and WhatsApp with a unified inbox and deliverability tools. Plans start at $69 per month ($55 billed annually) for the email plan, with a free trial; no permanent free plan was shown. Lead finding and outreach can also be run from a CRM or an AI assistant.
